As of 2026, he is 53 years old, and his birth date places him under the Cancer sign.

sections.heading: Akhilesh Yadav — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Akhilesh Yadav was born on 1 July 1973 in Etawah and Saifai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Mulayam Singh Yadav.
He studied at University of Mysore, University of Sydney and Rashtriya Military School, Dholpur.

sections.heading: Akhilesh Yadav — Career and Professional Work
paras: Akhilesh Yadav works primarily as a politician.

He has held the following offices: Member of the 13th Lok Sabha, Member of the 15th Lok Sabha, Member of the 17th Lok Sabha (2019–2022), Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh (2012–2017), Member of the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly (2022–present) and Member of Uttar Pradesh Legislative Council (2012–2019). He is affiliated with Samajwadi Party.
